data.name: Wooden Weapon
data.description: You can create a wooden club, quarterstaff, longspear, shortspear, or spear that lasts for %1 minutes. This weapon is appropriate for your size. You are considered proficient with the weapon. The weapon disappears after 1 round if it leaves your grasp. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|WoodenWeaponDuration|WoodenWeaponTimes|!PRECLASS:1,Oracle=3
